mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scheduled_jobs (job_type, business_key, reminder_id, node_type, scheduled_at, next_run_at, status, retry_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{jobType}, #{businessKey}, #{reminderId}, #{nodeType}, #{scheduledAt}, #{nextRunAt}, 'READY', 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (business_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO scheduled_jobs (job_type, business_key, habit_execution_id, node_type, scheduled_at, next_run_at, status, retry_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{jobType}, #{businessKey}, #{habitExecutionId}, #{nodeType}, #{scheduledAt}, #{nextRunAt}, 'READY', 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (business_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM scheduled_jobs WHERE (status IN ('READY', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND next_run_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_run_at, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE scheduled_jobs SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', assistant_message_id = #{assistantMessageId}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE scheduled_jobs SET status = 'RETRY_WAIT', next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE scheduled_jobs SET status = 'FAILED', last_error_code = #{errorCode}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE scheduled_jobs SET status = 'CANCELLED', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE reminder_id = #{reminderId} AND status IN ('READY', 'RETRY_WAIT', 'RUNNING')

UPDATE scheduled_jobs SET status = 'CANCELLED', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE job_type = 'HABIT_DELIVERY' AND business_key LIKE CONCAT('HABIT_DELIVERY:', #{habitId}, '%') AND status IN ('READY', 'RETRY_WAIT', 'RUNNING')
UPDATE scheduled_jobs SET status = 'MISSED', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE status IN ('READY', 'RETRY_WAIT', 'RUNNING') AND next_run_at <= #{deadline}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM scheduled_jobs WHERE habit_execution_id = #{habitExecutionId} ORDER BY id
